name: Lytical
description_en:
Lytical combines website event analytics, daily site scans, keyword and competitor monitoring, and an AI assistant called Quincy. Its documented workflow connects observed site behavior with technical and marketing context, rather than only presenting page-view totals. The homepage describes automatic tracking of clicks, form submissions and abandonments.

The product is relevant when a team wants to investigate its own website and bring connected marketing data into a shared analysis workspace. Automatic capture does not establish that every event is a correct business conversion, and AI recommendations do not prove a cause. The current pricing page contains contradictions that materially affect procurement.
description_zh:
Lytical 将网站事件分析、每日扫描、关键词及竞品监测，与名为 Quincy 的 AI 助手结合。文档流程把网站行为与技术、营销背景连接起来，而不只展示浏览量。首页描述自动追踪点击、表单提交及放弃。

当团队希望研究自己的网站，并将连接的营销数据带入共享分析空间时，可以评估此产品。自动采集不能证明每个事件都是正确的业务转化，AI 建议也不能证明原因。当前定价页存在会实质影响采购判断的矛盾。

core_features.explanation_en: Tracks page views, clicks and forms through a site script; event definitions still need validation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过网站脚本跟踪浏览、点击与表单，仍需验证事件定义。

core_features.explanation_en: Checks site changes and issues such as broken links and page performance.
core_features.explanation_zh: 检查网站变化、断链及页面性能等问题。

core_features.explanation_en: Uses website, scan and connected-tool data for natural-language insights.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结合网站、扫描与已连接工具的数据提供自然语言分析。

use_cases.basis: Editorial task and fit judgments grounded in the attached primary sources; no observed deployment.

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.
Research scope.zh: 核对公开文档与商业入口；示例是建议的评估流程。

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: The pricing FAQ instructs adding a script tag in the site head and describes separate tracking tokens per site. Confirm who can publish that script and what data it collects before connecting advertising or analytics accounts. Free lists unlimited team members, but multi-site statements conflict: cards advertise unlimited sites while the FAQ limits multi-site management to Pro and Enterprise. Integrations such as GA, GSC and Google Ads are listed on paid plans; HubSpot Sync is explicitly marked coming soon in the table.
steps.zh: 定价 FAQ 指示把脚本标签加入网站 head，并说明每站点有独立追踪令牌。连接广告或分析账户前，先确认谁能发布脚本、会采集哪些数据。免费列无限团队成员，但多站点说明冲突：卡片写无限站点，FAQ 却把多站点管理限于 Pro 和 Enterprise。GA、GSC、Google Ads 等集成列在付费档；表格明确把 HubSpot Sync 标为即将推出。

items.en: Shortlist this hosted service for a team wanting site analytics, technical checks and AI-assisted interpretation together. It is not demonstrated here as a replacement for a warehouse, guaranteed attribution model or incident-monitoring SLA. Validate duplicate events, script blocking and form success with known submissions. The vendor says tracking continues over quota, but the accessible-data rule is unclear; export and retention need confirmation. No open-source distribution or self-hosted deployment was established.
items.zh: 希望将站点分析、技术检查与 AI 解读放在一起的团队，可考虑此托管服务。本研究未证明它可替代数据仓库、保证性归因模型或事故监控 SLA。应通过已知提交验证重复事件、脚本阻挡和表单成功。厂商称超额仍继续跟踪，但可访问数据规则不清，需要确认导出与保留。未确认开源发行或自托管部署。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The Free plan is described as ongoing, without a card: 50,000 events/month, 10 weekly keywords, one daily competitor, 25 pages crawled daily and 25 AI chats/month. New accounts also get all features for 30 days before downgrading if not upgraded. Lyte is shown at $29/month and Pro at $99 on the card but $100 in the comparison table. Pro lists one million events. The FAQ claims only the first 100,000 events remain accessible after overage, without reconciling tier limits. Treat paid totals and overage access as unresolved, not a normalized quote.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free 被描述为持续免费且免信用卡：每月 50,000 事件、10 个每周更新关键词、一个每日更新竞品、每日扫描 25 页及每月 25 次 AI 对话。新账户另有 30 天全功能体验，未升级则降回免费。Lyte 展示每月 29 美元，Pro 卡片为 99 美元，但比较表为 100 美元；Pro 列一百万事件。FAQ 又称超额后只能访问前 100,000 事件，未解释与各档额度的关系。付费总额及超额访问应保留待确认，不归一化为报价。

official_check.scope: Public primary-source documentation only. No account execution, purchase, identity claim, price approval, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis with section-aligned Chinese translation. Vendor documentation is not an independent performance test.
Hypothetical workflows and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. No directional alternative relationship has been approved.
Evidence text and SHA-256 metadata retained in .scratch/deep-research/batch-12/lytical-045e27cf/; no source text copied into public descriptions.

sections.en: Suppose a landing-page edit is followed by fewer submitted leads. Compare submission and abandonment events with the scan history, inspect the changed page, and ask Quincy to summarize supporting evidence. Check the lead destination as well: an interaction counted in a browser is not necessarily a record successfully saved in a CRM. This is an evaluation design, not a measured customer result. Keep a before/after window and campaign mix visible so a simultaneous traffic change is not attributed to the page edit without evidence.
sections.zh: 假设修改落地页后线索提交减少，可比较提交与放弃事件和扫描历史，检查改动页面，并请 Quincy 总结支持证据。同时检查线索接收端：浏览器中的交互不一定已成功保存为 CRM 记录。这是评估设计，不是客户实测结果。应保留前后时间区间及活动组合，避免无证据地将同时发生的流量变化归因于页面修改。
